product: AI data-center memory: HBM4 and HBM4E for AI accelerators, DDR5 RDIMMs (world-first 512GB module at 9,200 MT/s, 2026-09-15, investors.micron.com), LP5X SOCAMM2 and high-capacity QLC NAND. Data center is about 50% of revenue (Motley Fool 2026-09-12).
demand: Price and mix, not units: FQ3-26 revenue rose 73.7% QoQ to $41.46B with GAAP gross margin 84.6% (2026-06-24) on pricing. HBM crowds out conventional DRAM. Barron's: memory-chip supply cannot keep up with demand (2026-09-21, aggregator).
pricing_power: A memory price rollover and a break in supply discipline: CXMT moved its latest DRAM into mass production (Invezz 2026-09-20) and plans NAND expansion (2026-09-18); new capacity lands 2027; DDR4 spot softening. The USITC patent probe is a legal risk (2026-09-24).
competition: Yes, but not at the leading edge. CXMT is mass-producing its latest DRAM (Invezz 2026-09-20) and planning NAND expansion (2026-09-18); YMTC won a first round against Micron in a NAND case (JUVE Patent 2026-09-24). Neither matches HBM4 today.
market_strategy: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra, 2026-06-24: FQ4-26 revenue $50.0B +/- $1.0B, GAAP gross margin approximately 86%, non-GAAP EPS $31.00 +/- $1.00; multi-year Strategic Customer Agreements to enhance durability and predictability. Said AI has changed memory demand (CNBC via Yahoo Finance 2026-08-21).
bull: FQ3-26 revenue $41.46B rose 73.7% QoQ with 84.6% GAAP gross margin (2026-06-24); FQ4 guide is $50.0B and ~86% margin, consensus EPS $31.56 above the $31.00 guide (AlphaStreet 2026-09-25). HBM4/DDR5 demand exceeds supply.
bear: Analyst target levels are perverse (§17): mean $1,515 implies huge upside but carries no signal. Wells Fargo cut 1525->1400 and Mizuho 1375->1300; CXMT mass-produces DRAM (Invezz 2026-09-20); USITC Netlist probe (2026-09-24); Burry short.
falsifier: The FQ4 FY2026 print due 2026-09-30: revenue below $49.0B, GAAP gross margin below ~86%, or non-GAAP EPS below $31.00 would prove the bull case wrong.

web_true_now_not_modelled: Micron is earning cycle-peak economics: guided FQ4-26 revenue $50.0B and about 86% GAAP gross margin (2026-06-24). RBC argues the market under-prices Strategic Customer Agreements that could re-rate the earnings profile (Yahoo Finance 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-26). Consensus FY26 EPS $73.57 implies about 14.7x forward P/E (stockanalysis 2026-09-25). HBM4 ramp timing is the open variable.
web_demand_product: AI data-center memory: HBM4 and HBM4E for AI accelerators, DDR5 RDIMMs (world-first 512GB module at 9,200 MT/s, 2026-09-15, investors.micron.com), LP5X SOCAMM2 and high-capacity QLC NAND. Data center is about 50% of revenue (Motley Fool 2026-09-12).
web_price_volume_mix: Price and mix, not units: FQ3-26 revenue rose 73.7% QoQ to $41.46B with GAAP gross margin 84.6% (2026-06-24) on pricing. HBM crowds out conventional DRAM. Barron's: memory-chip supply cannot keep up with demand (2026-09-21, aggregator).
web_bottleneck: Micron relieves a memory-supply bottleneck: HBM crowding out conventional DRAM tightens DDR5 supply, and Micron warned shortages may persist through 2027 (Yahoo Finance 2026-09-18). Its own constraint is leading-edge wafer capacity and advanced DRAM packaging (512GB module relies on it, 2026-09-15).
web_who_benefits_next: Wafer and materials suppliers: GlobalWafers financing of $500M inside Micron's up-to-$3B US plan (Reuters 2026-07-09). Semicap and advanced-packaging vendors enabling 512GB modules; server OEMs; TrendForce flags 2027 long-term-agreement price hikes (2026-09-25, aggregator).
web_who_loses: Handset and PC OEMs absorbing memory cost inflation; server makers and Netlist respondents in the USITC case (2026-09-24, PR Newswire); Samsung and SK hynix face HBM share pressure; Nvidia GPU economics pressured by HBM cost (Yahoo Finance 2026-09-11).
web_margin_collapse_risk: A memory price rollover and a break in supply discipline: CXMT moved its latest DRAM into mass production (Invezz 2026-09-20) and plans NAND expansion (2026-09-18); new capacity lands 2027; DDR4 spot softening. The USITC patent probe is a legal risk (2026-09-24).

web_did_they_deliver: So far yes: FQ3-26 record revenue $41.46B and GAAP gross margin 84.6% (2026-06-24). Q4 consensus EPS $31.56 is above the $31.00 guide (AlphaStreet 2026-09-25). Consensus Strong Buy, mean target $1,515 (stockanalysis 2026-09-25). FQ4 evidence lands 2026-09-30.
web_what_would_falsify: The FQ4 FY2026 print due 2026-09-30: revenue below $49.0B, GAAP gross margin below about 86%, or non-GAAP EPS below $31.00 would falsify it. Also a memory price rollover, or HBM4 revenue slipping into FY27 as Nvidia's Vera Rubin ramp shifts timing (Crypto Briefing 2026-09-25).
